namespace MigrationDriverTests
{

        {
            public Func<string, string, string[], Task<string>> SetSlotRangeAsync { get; set; }
            public Task<string> SetSlotRange(byte[] stateBytes, string nodeid, int[] slots)
            {
                return SetSlotRangeAsync?.Invoke("", nodeid, slots) ?? Task.FromResult("OK");
            }
        }

        private class DummyClusterManager
        {
            public static int[] GetRange(int[] slots) => slots;
        }

        private class DummyLogger : ILogger
        {
            public LogLevel LogLevel => LogLevel.Trace;
            public readonly System.Collections.Generic.List<string> Logs = new();

            public IDisposable BeginScope<TState>(TState state) => null;
            public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => true;
            public void Log<TState>(LogLevel logLevel, EventId eventId, TState state, Exception exception, Func<TState, Exception, string> formatter)
            {
                Logs.Add(formatter(state, exception));
            }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsTraceAndReturnsTrueOnSuccess()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new DummyLogger();
            var session = new DummyMigrateSession
            {
                Logger = logger,
                Client = new DummyClient
                {
                    SetSlotRangeAsync = (stateBytes, nodeid, slots) => Task.FromResult("OK")

                Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10),
                CtsToken = new CancellationToken(),
                Status = MigrateState.PENDING,
                Slots = new int[] { 1, 2, 3 },
                MigrateOperation = new[] { new { Client = new DummyClient() } }
            };

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.IMPORT);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
            Assert.Contains("Sending CLUSTER SETSLOTRANGE", logger.Logs[0]);
            Assert.Contains("[Completed] SETSLOT", logger.Logs[^1]);
        }

namespace MigrationDriverTests

    public class MigrationDriverLoggingTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsTraceMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var clientMock = new Mock<GarnetClientSession>();
            clientMock.Setup(c => c.IsConnected).Returns(true);
            clientMock.Setup(c => c.ReconnectAsync(It.IsAny<int>())).Returns(Task.CompletedTask);

            // Assert

using Xunit;
using Moq;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace MigrationLoggingTests
{
    // A minimal class to test the logging behavior of CheckConnectionAsync
    public class TestMigration
    {
        public class DummyLogger : ILogger
        {
            public readonly System.Collections.Generic.List<string> Logs = new();

            public IDisposable BeginScope<TState>(TState state) => null;
            public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => true;
            public void Log<TState>(LogLevel logLevel, EventId eventId, TState state, Exception exception, Func<TState, Exception, string> formatter)
            {
                Logs.Add(formatter(state, exception));
            }
        }

        public async Task TestLogTraceOnCheckConnectionAsync()
        {
            var logger = new DummyLogger();

            var mockClient = new Mock<GarnetClientSession>();
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.IsConnected).Returns(false);
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.ReconnectAsync(It.IsAny<int>())).Returns(Task.CompletedTask);
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.Authenticate(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<string>()))
                .ReturnsAsync("OK");
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.WaitAsync(It.IsAny<TimeSpan>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                .ReturnsAsync("OK");

            var dummy = new DummyDependency
            {
                Client = mockClient.Object,
                Logger = logger,
                Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10),
                CtsToken = new CancellationToken()
            };

            // Call the method
            var result = await dummy.CheckConnectionAsync();

            // Verify that LogTrace was called
            Assert.Contains(logger.Logs, log => log.Contains("Sending CLUSTER SETSLOTRANGE"));
        }

        // Dummy class to hold the method under test
        private class DummyDependency
        {
            public GarnetClientSession Client { get; set; }
            public ILogger Logger { get; set; }
            public TimeSpan Timeout { get; set; }
            public CancellationToken CtsToken { get; set; }

            public async Task<bool> CheckConnectionAsync()
            {
                if (!Client.IsConnected)
                {
                    await Client.ReconnectAsync((int)Timeout.TotalMilliseconds);
                    var authResp = await Client.Authenticate("user", "pass").WaitAsync(Timeout, CtsToken);
                    Logger.Log(LogLevel.Trace, new EventId(), $"Sending CLUSTER SETSLOTRANGE {authResp}", null, (s, e) => s.ToString());
                    if (!authResp.Equals("OK", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    {
                        Logger.Log(LogLevel.Error, new EventId(), $"Auth failed: {authResp}", null, (s, e) => s.ToString());
                        return false;
                    }
                    return true;
                }
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
}
